description: Lists the three houses of Mondschein in Stuben: Ski Hotel Mondschein (4 stars, since 1739), Mondschein Chalet (private spa suites, open all year) and Arlberg Motel. Returns id, name, short description, number of room types and the page URL. Use list_rooms with the house id next.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

name: list_houses

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: The three houses
